comment_regular: DialoguePackage cursor/playback state machine. Speak(true) performs audible HighProcess playback; Speak(false) advances silently with no new timer. With waitingForLip clear, each false call advances one response cursor and can commit an exhausted item while selecting the next. With waitingForLip set, false calls cannot clear the flag or advance, so MiddleHigh execution stalls until HighProcess playback resumes or the package is destroyed.
